description: BNDES Mobilidade Brasil provides indicators and georeferenced layers from Brazil's 2024 National Urban Mobility Study, mapping high- and medium-capacity transport projects. The provider is BNDES. Geographical and temporal coverage: The study covers 21 Brazilian metropolitan regions; the portal identifies the individual areas. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): ODbL-1.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
